execution.policy: Sequential systemd user scopes; resource check independently read its cgroup limits

source_boundaries.software.xml: Focused checks ran before the source commit; the tested implementation and test contents are preserved at source_commit.
source_boundaries.full-software.xml: Full suite ran on the committed source.
source_boundaries.resources.json: Resource check verifies committed inputs and reports its source revision and exact hashes.

checks: Terminal history matches full reconstruction for archive and double precision.
Chunked validation/hash matches the original array identity for noncontiguous and memory-mapped arrays.
Normal and Student-t batch noise exactly slices the original full stream.
Batch sizes preserve the full forecast within floating-point tolerance, including the last singleton draw.
Nonfinite final input is rejected before any forecast batch is yielded.
All synthetic workload draws are processed and every resulting state is finite.
limitations: Resource results are from local synthetic parameter arrays at the committed design shape, not fitted driver values.
The baseline memory figure is an allocation lower bound, not a measured baseline peak or speed comparison.
Compressed accepted-posterior loading, an intended CI runner and end-to-end refresh resources remain unverified.
The collecting convenience wrapper retains all forecast output; bounded consumers must consume every iterator range and release processed batches.
These checks do not establish convergence, recovery, calibration or predictive improvement.
